ai_app_top20.readme_highlight: Two findings shaped caveman. Adobe: cavemanning your prompt makes answers worse, so caveman never touches your prompt. JetBrains: agent sessions are mostly code and tool calls, which the voice leaves alone. So caveman grew rocks that shrink what the agent reads and what it runs on.

ai_app_top20.readme_highlight: The Python library is free and MIT-licensed. Model inference and hosted browsers are separate: API providers, including ChatBrowserUse, and Browser Use Cloud charge for usage. You can also use a local browser and a local model through Ollama, subject to your hardware and model requirements.
